subject.title: feat(ui): add message preview to session list

question: Should this stale PR remain the landing path for the Control UI session-list preview feature, or should maintainers ask for a current-main replacement tied to the canonical feature issue?
rationale: The feature is useful and backend support exists, but the submitted branch is stale, incorrect, and overlaps with broader Sessions overview direction; automation cannot choose the permanent UX path or provide the contributor's real behavior proof.

options.title: Require Current-Main Replacement
options.body: Ask for a focused replacement or major refresh against `ui/src/pages/sessions/*` that uses `includeLastMessage`, removes the planning note, and includes redacted browser proof.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Sessions Overview
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open but pause this PR until maintainers decide the wider sessions overview design owns previews.

options.title: Decline Table Previews
options.body: Close the paired preview work with a maintainer UX rationale if the Sessions table should remain a technical management view.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Main Replacement
recommendation.body: Ask for a focused replacement or major refresh against `ui/src/pages/sessions/*` that uses `includeLastMessage`, removes the planning note, and includes redacted browser proof.
